citation: Luscombe-Marsh ND, Hutchison AT, et al. Plasma Free Amino Acid Responses to Intraduodenal Whey Protein, and Relationships with Insulin, Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 and Energy Intake in Lean Healthy Men. Nutrients 2016.
protocol: Fasted; 60-min intraduodenal infusions of hydrolysed whey protein at 2.1, 6.3 or 12.5 kJ/min (8, 24 or 48 g total protein, printed in the infusion table) or saline, double-blind crossover; serum insulin and plasma GLP-1 summarised as AUC 0-60 min, amino acids printed as AUCs; buffet meal after the infusion
population: n=16 healthy lean men, age 27 +/- 3 y (range 19-54), BMI 22.1 +/- 0.6
note: Protein with no carbohydrate, graded in three doses, but by intraduodenal infusion (bypasses the stomach), so a reader should say plainly that it is not a drink. Insulin and GLP-1 are areas only; time courses are in figures. Glucose and glucagon are not printed.
